title: Introduction to Aerospace Engineering
description: This course introduces students to the fundamental disciplines of aerospace engineering including design, build, test, and operation of flight vehicles. Fundamental aerospace topics will be introduced including: aerodynamics, structures, propulsion, vehicle dynamics and control, orbital dynamics and space systems engineering. This course includes computer-aided design (CAD) and a hands-on aerospace engineering experience.
prerequisites: EGR 103 or EGR 215 or consent of Director of Undergraduate Studies
